crossRefs.note: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.
When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at…

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

people.name: Rhoda
people.line: Servant girl in the house of Mary

translations.web: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
translations.bsb: He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.
translations.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
translations.asv: And when he knocked at the door of the gate, a maid came to answer, named Rhoda.
